chunks: And with the foregoing chain of narration from Ali ibn Mahzyar, raising it to Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, who said: The Commander of the Faithful, may Allah's blessings be upon him, used to say:
"Bring near to yourselves that which is distant, and make easy upon yourselves that which is difficult.

And know that a servant, even if his strategy is weak and his plan is feeble, will never have reduced from what Allah has destined for him. And even if he is strong in the intensity of his strategy and the power of his plan, he will never have increased beyond what Allah has destined for him."

key_terms.الشَّدِيد: the difficult — severe or hard matters in life
key_terms.الْبَعِيد: the distant — referring to goals or matters that seem far away
key_terms.حِيلَة: strategy or cunning — human scheming and resourcefulness
key_terms.مَكِيدَة: plan or plot — schemes devised through effort

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about divine destiny and human strategy?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) teaches that one should adopt a courageous mindset by considering distant goals as near and difficult tasks as easy. He emphasizes the doctrine of divine decree (qadar): no human strategy, whether weak or powerful, can change what Allah has allotted to a person. This teaching was delivered to encourage believers to rely on Allah rather than on their own cunning, reflecting the Shia emphasis on tawakkul (reliance on God) alongside personal effort.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 39. And with the foregoing chain of narration from ‘Ali ibn Mahzyar, raising it up to Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, who said: Amirul Mu’mineen, ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, used to say:
"Always consider that which is distant as quite near and that which is difficult as very easy.

And, know that, even if a slave of Allah is weak in his strategy and having failing in his plans, it will not reduce anything from what Allah has destined for him. And if he is powerful in his strategy and forceful in his plan, it will not increase anything in what Allah has destined for him."
